name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
perk: Free bundle of developer tools and services for verified students.
details: Free GitHub Pro for your personal account plus a bundle of partner tools and credits while you're a student.
requirements: Age 13 or older and enrolled in a degree- or diploma-granting program. Verify with a school email or proof of enrollment through GitHub Education.
caveats: Approval time varies. Partner offers can have their own limits. An academic email can only be used for one pack.

name: JetBrains Student License
perk: Free educational licenses for JetBrains IDEs for students.
details: Free personal license for JetBrains IDEs, for non-commercial learning.
requirements: Student at an accredited school, college or university in a program of a year or longer. Apply with a school email, an ISIC/ITIC card, or your GitHub Student Developer Pack.
caveats: Valid for one year, renewable while you're still studying. Non-commercial use only and can't be shared. Bootcamps and online courses don't qualify.

name: Microsoft Azure for Students
perk: Free Azure access with student credits and selected services.
details: Azure for Students includes a credit for eligible new customers and access to selected free services. Microsoft says the subscription can be renewed annually while you remain a student.
requirements: Full-time student at an accredited degree-granting institution, with academic verification
caveats: Credits expire after the offer period and unused credits do not carry over. Usage beyond included amounts can require an upgrade, so review Azure spending controls.

name: Autodesk Education
perk: Free one-year access to Autodesk software for eligible students.
details: The Autodesk Education plan can include software such as AutoCAD, Maya, Revit, and Fusion. Access is renewable annually while eligibility continues.
requirements: Student at a qualified educational institution and able to complete Autodesk's eligibility verification
caveats: Education access is for learning and research only, not commercial or professional work. Software and eligibility rules can vary.

name: Zed Student Plan
perk: Free Zed Pro for one year for verified university students.
details: The student plan includes Zed Pro features, real-time collaboration, unlimited edit predictions, and monthly AI token credits.
requirements: At least 18 years old and currently enrolled at an accredited university
caveats: The student plan downgrades to the free plan after one year. AI model availability and included credits can change.

name: Replit Student Discount
perk: Discounted Replit Core for students with an eligible school email.
details: Replit's student page describes an education offer for students who verify with a school email address.
requirements: Student with an eligible .edu or school email address
caveats: The discount applies to a paid plan and the current price, billing terms, and verification rules can change. Replit also has a separate free Starter plan.

name: Codecademy Pro Student
perk: Reduced-price Codecademy Pro access for eligible students.
details: Codecademy's Student Center says eligible students can access Pro features at more than 35% below the regular price.
requirements: Student status verification through Codecademy's student offer
caveats: The offer is for eligible students and the final price may vary by plan, country, taxes, and billing period.

name: Notion for Education
perk: Free upgraded plan for students and educators with a school email.
details: Free Plus plan for a one-member workspace, with unlimited uploads and up to 100 guests.
requirements: Student or educator at an accredited college or university, signed in with your school email. Personal emails and student IDs are not accepted.
caveats: Not available to K-12. Upgrade on desktop or web, not mobile, from a Free-plan workspace with one member. If your school isn't recognized, Notion can add it if it's in the WHED.

name: Canva for Education
perk: Free for K-12 students and teachers. College students get Canva Free, with Pro only if their school offers Canva for Campus.
details: Canva Pro features are free through Canva for Education for K-12. College students use Canva Free.
requirements: K-12 student whose teacher or school is verified by Canva. Students cannot sign up on their own. College and university students are not eligible.
caveats: The teacher or school handles verification, and Canva re-checks eligibility every three years. Some colleges offer Canva for Campus, so ask your school.

name: Figma Education
perk: Free Education plan for verified students and educators.
details: Figma Education gives students the Professional plan for free, including Figma Design, FigJam, Slides and Dev Mode.
requirements: Current student or educator. Higher-ed students verify through SheerID. High school accounts need a school-provided email. Sign-ups with a company or professional email can be declined.
caveats: Figma AI features are not included. Figma cannot review documents itself, so verification problems go to SheerID.

name: Microsoft 365 Education
perk: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams for students through eligible schools.
details: Sign up with a school email address. Device discounts and Microsoft 365 Personal student pricing vary by country.
requirements: A school email address from an eligible institution
caveats: Availability and terms can depend on your school and country.

name: Adobe Creative Cloud for Students
perk: Discounted Creative Cloud plans for students.
details: Discounted Creative Cloud for students, with a first-year introductory rate (Adobe advertises about 71% off) and a 7-day trial.
requirements: Age 13 or older and enrolled in a school, college or university. Verified by school email or an uploaded enrollment document.
caveats: The price rises to the standard student rate after year one and Adobe may ask you to re-verify. Pricing and eligibility documents vary by country.

name: Spotify Premium Student
perk: Discounted Premium plan for verified students. Availability varies by country.
details: Student pricing is only offered in some countries, so check Spotify's student page for your country. Verification goes through SheerID.
requirements: Enrolled at an accredited higher-education institution
caveats: Must re-verify every 12 months, up to four years. Introductory promotions and prices change, so confirm the current offer before subscribing.

name: YouTube Premium Student
perk: Discounted membership for verified students. Availability varies by country.
details: Student memberships are only offered in some countries, so check YouTube's list of supported locations. Verification goes through SheerID when you sign up.
requirements: Enrolled at a higher education institution that SheerID supports
caveats: Student pricing lasts up to 4 consecutive years and you must re-verify every year. Cancel any active paid YouTube membership before switching. Prices have changed before, so none are listed here.

name: Apple Education Store
perk: Education pricing on Mac and iPad for students.
details: Apple runs a separate Education Store for each country. Open the Education page and choose your country's store before you buy.
requirements: Verified higher-education student, parent buying for a student, or educator
caveats: Apple limits how many discounted items you can buy per year. Promos such as gift-card offers are time-limited.

name: Amazon Prime Student
perk: Discounted Prime for students where Prime Student is offered (such as the US and UK). Not available in every country.
details: Half-price Prime after a 6-month free trial. Availability and pricing vary by country, so check Amazon's Prime Student page for yours. US sources list $7.49 per month or $69 per year.
requirements: College student, or age 18 to 24 with ID verification. The trial is for new members only.
caveats: Ends after 4 years, at age 25 or at graduation, then converts to regular Prime. Availability and pricing outside the US vary, so check it is offered in your country.

name: Grammarly
perk: Grammarly lists a limited-time 50% student discount on Pro, verified through SheerID. Check that it is still running.
details: Free access if your school has a Grammarly for Education license. Some student discounts are also offered at checkout.
requirements: Current student. Free access depends on your school having a license, so ask your school or library.
caveats: Individual student discounts are not clearly advertised and sources disagree on them. Check Grammarly directly before buying.

name: Google AI Plus for Students
perk: Free year of Google AI Plus for eligible college and university students.
details: Includes 400 GB of storage and higher Gemini usage limits. Sign in with your personal Google account, open Google's student offer page, and verify your student status through SheerID.
requirements: Enrolled at a higher education institution, 18 or older, using a personal Google account (school accounts and Family Link accounts do not qualify). Each student can redeem it once. Not available in the US, Hong Kong, Macau, Tunisia, Bolivia, Albania or Canada.
caveats: Redeem by December 31, 2026. A payment method is required at sign-up, and after 12 months the plan switches to the regular paid price unless you cancel. Not available in every country, so check the offer page for yours.

name: Perplexity Education Pro
perk: Discounted Perplexity Pro for verified students.
details: Education Pro includes everything in Perplexity Pro. Verify as a student through SheerID from the upgrade menu in the app, and the education discount is applied automatically.
requirements: A verified student. Verification runs through SheerID, and your school has to be in SheerID's list (you can ask SheerID to add a missing school).
caveats: Perplexity does not publish which countries are supported, so make sure your school verifies before you pay. The discount is tied to the email you verified with and can't be transferred. Pricing can change.

name: Bootstrap Studio Student License
perk: Free one-year license for Bootstrap Studio for students.
details: Free student license for Bootstrap Studio, a desktop app for building responsive websites with the Bootstrap framework.
requirements: Current student. Apply on the official page with your student email and a website.
caveats: Valid for one year and renewable while you're still a student. Non-commercial use only, on a single computer, with one activation at a time.

name: GitKraken Student Pack
perk: 6 months of GitKraken Pro features free for students, then a discounted student rate.
details: Pro features in GitKraken Desktop and GitLens, claimed through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
requirements: A verified GitHub Student Developer Pack. Create your GitKraken account with the GitHub sign-in option so the student license syncs.
caveats: The free period is 6 months from your student account creation. After that you pay a discounted rate while you stay verified. Add a payment method if you want to keep access.

name: Tower Git Client for Students
perk: Free 12 months of Tower Pro for enrolled students.
details: Tower Pro, a Git client for Windows and Mac, free for students. No payment details needed.
requirements: Enrolled student. Apply with your school email address.
caveats: Valid for 12 months and can be extended if you reconfirm your student status. Bootcamp students should ask their instructor to apply through Tower for Education.

name: Tableau for Students
perk: Free one-year Tableau Desktop and Tableau Prep license for students.
details: Full Tableau Desktop and Prep license for learning and data analysis, free for students at accredited schools.
requirements: Currently enrolled at an accredited school. Fill in the form and upload proof of enrollment.
caveats: One-year license, renewable while you are still a student. For learning use, not commercial work. Terms can change, so check the page.

name: Axure RP for Students
perk: Free Axure RP Team edition for students.
details: Prototyping and documentation software, free for students and teachers at accredited schools.
requirements: Student at an accredited high school, university or community college. Submit the education license request and wait for approval.
caveats: One-year subscription, renewable each year you are enrolled. Not for commercial use. Approval is by Axure and can take time.

name: Codecov for Students
perk: Free Codecov code coverage for students through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
details: Code coverage reporting for your repositories, free for students and educators.
requirements: A verified GitHub Student Developer Pack.
caveats: An admin of your GitHub org has to approve Codecov before you can use it.

name: AlgoExpert Student Offer
perk: Student discount on AlgoExpert coding interview prep through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
details: AlgoExpert is part of the Pack's Career Readiness offers.
requirements: A verified GitHub Student Developer Pack.
caveats: Terms change often. Check your GitHub Education dashboard for the current offer before buying.

name: Namecheap Free .me Domain
perk: Free .me domain for one year for students.
details: One .me domain free for a year, with an SSL certificate, claimed through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
requirements: A verified GitHub Student Developer Pack.
caveats: Free for the first year only. It renews at the standard price afterwards.

name: Frontend Masters Student Offer
perk: Free access to Frontend Masters courses through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
details: Frontend Masters partners with the GitHub Student Developer Pack to give students six months of free access to its platform.
requirements: A verified GitHub Student Developer Pack.
caveats: The free period is time-limited, so claim it when you are ready to use it.

name: Codedex Club Student Offer
perk: Free Codedex Club premium membership through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
details: The GitHub Student Developer Pack lists six months of free Codedex Club for verified students.
requirements: A verified GitHub Student Developer Pack.
caveats: The free period is time-limited. Claim it from your GitHub Education pack page.

name: Educative Student Offer
perk: Free Educative courses through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
details: Verify your student status through GitHub on Educative's student page and the offer is applied to your account. No credit card is needed.
requirements: A verified GitHub Student Developer Pack.
caveats: Terms change often. Check the current offer on Educative's page before relying on it.

name: DataCamp Student Offer
perk: Free months of DataCamp through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
details: DataCamp gives verified Pack members three months of free access to its data courses.
requirements: A verified GitHub Student Developer Pack. For students who are not already DataCamp subscribers.
caveats: The free period is time-limited. Claim it from your GitHub Education pack page.

name: Deepnote Education Plan
perk: Free Education plan for data science notebooks for students and educators.
details: The free Education plan gives access to Deepnote's collaborative notebooks and features, and is also part of the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
requirements: A student or educator at an accredited school. Verify with a school email.
caveats: You need to re-verify once a year. If your school email is not recognized automatically, Deepnote can verify you manually, which can take a few days.

name: Framer for Students
perk: Free Framer access for student portfolios and class projects.
details: Framer's student program covers hosting a portfolio or personal site and full access to the design canvas and CMS.
requirements: Enrolled in a certified in-person or online program, such as a high school, college or university. Apply on Framer's student page.
caveats: For personal sites, portfolios and class projects only. Commercial projects need a paid plan.

name: DigitalOcean Student Credit
perk: Free hosting credit for verified students through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
details: Cloud hosting credit that you claim through your GitHub Student Developer Pack, usable on DigitalOcean servers and services.
requirements: An approved GitHub Student Developer Pack, and a DigitalOcean account that meets the offer's terms.
caveats: Credit amount and how long it lasts are set by DigitalOcean and can change. Confirm the current terms in the GitHub Pack offers list.

name: .tech Student Domain
perk: Heavily discounted .tech domain registration for verified students.
details: A discounted first-year registration of a .tech domain for your projects and portfolio, claimed through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
requirements: An approved GitHub Student Developer Pack.
caveats: Renewal pricing and referral terms are set by .tech. Check the current terms before you register.

name: Dashlane Premium for Students
perk: One free year of Dashlane Premium for students.
details: A free year of the Dashlane password manager's Premium plan, with a student email address.
requirements: A valid student or university email address.
caveats: Availability and eligibility can depend on your country or school. The student trial does not include the VPN, and it ends one year after you sign up.

name: Evernote Student Discount
perk: Discount on a paid Evernote plan for verified students.
details: A student discount on an annual paid Evernote plan for taking and organizing notes across your devices.
requirements: Verified student status. The offer is for students who don't currently have a paid Evernote subscription.
caveats: Discount amount and eligible plans can change. Some schools' email domains may not qualify, so confirm on the official page before you pay.

name: Unreal Engine for Students and Schools
perk: Epic's education program for students and schools, with free institutional licensing and classroom resources.
details: Epic Games' education page for Unreal Engine, covering licensing for schools and learning resources for classrooms.
requirements: Check the official page for who qualifies. Access is arranged through an educational institution.
caveats: The offline installer request on this page is for school administrators, not students. Ask your school first, and confirm the current terms on the official page.
